name: Plainfield Twp Salt Shed
hero_alt: Building shell under construction at Plainfield Township Salt Shed
paragraphs: Plainfield Township needed a dedicated storage building for winter road salt, and Kobalt Construction delivered a ground-up structure with poured concrete walls built to keep materials dry and ready for winter maintenance operations.
The finished building gives the township's public works crew a durable, low-maintenance facility designed to stand up to years of heavy use.
